name: Ocal Browser v8.6.00 (Stable)
body:
OCAL BROWSER - STABLE RELEASE CATALOG
Version: 8.6.00 Stable
Release Date: August 16, 2026

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[SHOWROOM-GRADE AI INTELLIGENCE & CHAT WORKSPACE]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* SHOWROOM-GRADE CHAT UI: Elevated message cards, dynamic personality badges, glowing sparkle avatars, integrated code block headers with dedicated copy buttons.
* TTS VOICE & RESPONSE ACTIONS: Added interactive footer action bar beneath AI responses with full-response copy and native SpeechSynthesis read-aloud TTS capabilities.
* REFINED PERSONA BEHAVIORS: Strict personality boundaries addressing the user professionally or technically, isolating companion nicknames exclusively to companion persona modes.
* ZERO-FAILURE WEB SUMMARIZER: Multi-source DOM scraper extracting OpenGraph metadata, headings hierarchy, and structured content from SPAs (Next.js/React/Vercel) with rich executive summary cards when offline.
* NATURAL LANGUAGE BROWSER CONTROL: Direct natural language instructions to toggle themes, 25+ accent colors, Shields, search engines, and tabs in real time.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[HIGH-PRECISION NATIVE RIGHT-CLICK CONTEXT MENU]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NATIVE OS CURSOR POPUP: Fixed context menu rendering by eliminating DPI coordinate distortion and preventing duplicate event listener cancellation.
* ADVANCED WEB ACTIONS: Added Google Lens image search, Ask Ocal AI selection analyzer, split-view link launcher, page source viewer, print dialog, and dictionary spellchecking.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ENGINE & EXTENSION UPGRADES]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* CORE ENGINE: Upgraded to Electron 43.4.0 with optimized Chromium runtime.
* EXTENSIONS MATRIX: Updated uBlock Origin to v1.73.0 and Return YouTube Dislike to v4.0.4.
* INNO SETUP PACKAGING: Modern lzma2/ultra64 compression installer with custom icon branding.
